company.name: Tilt
company.shortDescription: Tilt's mission is to price the world's information —build an investable index for anything
company.description: Agora Intelligence (makers of Tilt) have combined institutional-grade investment tools with modern AI technologies and distribution through publishers, to enable anyone to build an index in minutes. With $280bn in thematic AUM looking to increase or reduce their exposure to themes, and ETFs requiring $50m in AUM to stay afloat, the opportunity for a long-tail index construction approach that moves 100x faster at 1/10th the cost, will fill an important gap in capital markets for investors that need to position themselves as quickly as the world changes.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for creating and managing investment indices and portfolios based on themes, exposures, research signals, exclusions, and investor preferences.
productsAndServices.name: Tilt Custom Indexing Platform

productsAndServices.description: Portfolio construction and management functionality that applies tax optimization, including tax-loss harvesting, while incorporating risk controls and investor preferences.
productsAndServices.name: Tax-Aware Portfolio Management

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted interface for defining rules-based, tax-aware, and preference-driven portfolios using natural-language instructions.
productsAndServices.name: Natural-Language Portfolio Builder

productsAndServices.description: A catalog of market, sector, and thematic indices that users can explore, follow, combine, and use as inputs for custom allocations.
productsAndServices.name: Tilt Index Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: API-driven infrastructure for index creation, data ingestion, portfolio modeling, and high-frequency rebalancing, with deployment through private cloud or embedded tools.
productsAndServices.name: Tilt Index APIs and Infrastructure

productsAndServices.description: A research platform that organizes expert and organizational perspectives across market topics and uses them to support thematic investment research.
